title: Page 3
slug: 捡夫宝娘子-金妍-戚家四兄弟只剩他戚无双这个当家老大还未娶妻-看弟弟们恩爱成双加上每天被媒婆们当大肥羊紧盯著-他烦不胜烦
content_zh:
第1章(2)
“什么？”宝安儿讶异地倒抽一口气，五千两？或是娶她？这种报答方式会不会太过狮子大开口了，她根本就说不出口呀！
“小姐，妳一定要好好把握机会。”贵叔努力地说服她。“虽然吴双现在还想不起自己的身世，但肯定不是普通人家，所以妳现在最好和他打好关系，甚至让他喜欢上妳，等他恢复记忆之后，就要他娶妳作报答，这样妳就可以过着荣华富贵的生活，再也不必像现在这么辛苦了。”
宝家虽然衰败了，但小姐还是千金之躯呀，他绝不会眼睁睁看着小姐为了生活而辛苦，每天得出门卖包子，眼前吴双就是个好目标，他当然得帮小姐想办法牢牢抓住才行！
况且小姐年幼时，已过世的老爷曾经请人帮小姐算过命，说小姐是个有福气之人，所以现在宝家虽然非常落魄，导致小姐都芳龄二十了也没有人想娶，他还是相信小姐绝对能找到富贵人家嫁出去。
“不行，我不能接受以身相许这种报答方法。”宝安儿断然拒绝。“况且他能不能恢复记忆还是个未知数，贵叔你现在想这么多也没用。”
她可不想拿自己的终身幸福开玩笑，如果不是她喜欢的男人，她才不嫁，而且如果吴双早已经有妻室那怎么办？
“可是小姐……”
“贵叔，暂时别再说了，等吴双真恢复记忆了，你再来谈这些也不迟。”她知道贵叔是为了她好，但这种事情真的是勉强不来的。
“那……好吧。”贵叔只好暂时闭嘴了，但并不表示他已经放弃这个打算。
反正未来会变得如何，还是个未知数，那就且战且走，伺机而动吧！
戚无双整整躺在床上半个月，内伤终于好了八成，有时候是宝安儿亲自过来照顾，有时候则是贵叔来照顾，似乎这座屋子除了他这位“不速之客”之外，就只有他们两个人住在这儿。
后来听贵叔说才知道，宝家原本是做古董生意的，家大奴仆也多，但自从家道中落之后，奴仆陆续四散，现在这座大宅子只剩宝安儿和贵叔了。
这一天，宝安儿照例又端药来给戚无双喝，天知道他每喝一帖药，她的心就淌一次血，全是为了那落入别人口袋的银两而哀悼呀！
在他喝完药之后，她努力压下心头淌血的感受，漾着笑，关心地问：“吴双，你觉得今天身子状况如何？”
“好很多了，这都要谢谢妳。”他有礼地笑答，现在的他寄人篱下养伤，态度自然多有收敛，表现出好相处的无害模样。
你的确是该谢我的一时失手！“所以……你今天有没有回想起任何和自己有关的事情？”她双眼闪亮亮，非常希望他能回答她——有！
“很抱歉，没有。”
“唉，果然……”她沮丧地大叹口气，每天都问他同样问题，他也回答了整整半个月同样答案，她早该死心才对。“你还真是随遇而安呀，这样子还笑得出来？”
如果是她失去记忆，大概早已慌得不知所措，偏偏他却还是稳如泰山，好像失去记忆这件事对他一点打击都没有。

“我大难不死，能够捡回一条命已经是万幸，就算真的找不回过往记忆，我也只能早点看开，毕竟日子还是得过下去的，不是吗？”他故意装得一副很豁达的样子。
“也是啦……”宝安儿点点头，也就不再多问。“你能看开那就好。”
她一直希望他能尽早恢复记忆，这样她就可以把这个烫手山芋丢还给他的家人，将整件事完全了结，但现在看来她也别太指望他能够恢复记忆，那个“最坏的打算”势必得拿出来和他谈谈了。
宝安儿将放在桌旁的圆凳搬到床边，然后坐下，原本的笑容收起，以一种非常慎重的表情说道：“吴双，既然你的内伤已经好了八成，我想……是有些事情该和你谈谈了。”
“我洗耳恭听。”他隐隐含笑，等着看她想出什么招。
宝安儿斟酌着到底该如何开口，而看着他想着想着，竟不知不觉开始注意起他的样貌。
他看起来就像个翩翩贵公子，就算现在身上只穿着她准备的粗布衣裳，还是难掩身上若隐若现的贵气，而他原本的那一件紫衫，早已破损不堪，虽然心疼那质料之好，她还是不得不丢弃。
况且他一勾起笑，那俊逸的笑容简直像在引诱姑娘们犯罪，连她的心也不受控制地怦然跳动，教她害羞又气恼，恼自己居然也会被男色所惑。
所以她不否认，他是个很好看、很吸引人的男人，非常有迷惑女人的本钱，甚至会让女人心甘情愿为他牺牲奉献也不一定。
但这却不代表，她也会被他给迷昏头，因为她非常有自知之明，自己没本钱养小白脸！
“咳咳，就算是亲兄弟，也得明算帐。”她有些尴尬地终于起了一个头。“因为将你给救回来，前前后后我到底花出去多少银两，我想有必要让你明白一下。”
戚无双挑了挑眉，兴味盎然，等她接着说下去。
宝安儿直接从袖袋里掏出一只小巧精致的木制算盘，当着他的面滴滴答答开始算起来。
“你待在我这里，大夫出诊一次花费一两银，总共来了两次；一帖药要价一百文钱，你喝了半个月，总共四十五帖；你住在这里我还得供给你三餐，一天的食膳花费约五十文钱，还有帮你准备的换洗衣裳总共五套，一套算二百文钱，所以林林总总的加起来……”宝安儿将打好的算盘移到他面前，笑得有些奸诈。“八两又二百五十文钱，救一个人还真不是一件简单容易的事。”
“所以？”戚无双忍着笑，因为她斤斤计较皱着眉打算盘的表情，在他眼里看来真的很逗趣。
“所以，看你是要在宝家做牛做马抵这些债，还是赶紧出去找个工作赚钱好将这些钱给清掉。”她又开始打起算盘。“我可先说，我没本事当什么大善人，所以该算的一文钱都不能漏，你如果出去找工作的话，好一点一个月可以挣个三到五两银都有可能，或许你三个月不到就能还完债，但如果你打算在宝家做牛做马抵债，我一个月最多只能给你抵一两银，这样你得在这儿做八个月白工才行。”
其实她希望他最好能够出去找工作挣钱，要是留他下来做牛做马，她也没什么活儿好让他做的，怎么算还是她亏比较多。
何况是男人，就该争气点出去打拚，别再给她添麻烦了！
戚无双眸中闪过一记精光，要算钱的事情，难道他会比她差？讨价还价可是他最在行的事情。
这半个月因为在养伤，他也就乖乖当个病人，任由她搓圆捏扁，既然现在伤已经好得差不多，而她也向他出招了，要他再伪装本性，让她仗着救命恩情一路压榨他，那怎么行？

他可是不吃亏的人，想要在他身上贪小便宜，也得看她有没有那个能耐！
戚无双勾起唇角，微瞇带笑的眸光瞬间锐利起来，正式回招了——
“宝小姐，我觉得妳似乎算错了。”
“怎么可能？”她可是每天都在拨算盘的，对钱的事情她一向小心翼翼，绝对不会算错的。
“要不，换我算给妳听。”戚无双拿过宝安儿手中的算盘，指头非常利落的拨着算珠，速度比宝安儿还要快。
content_en:
Chapter 1(2)
"What?" Bao An'er gasped in surprise, five thousand taels? Or marry her? Wouldn't this way of repaying her be too much for the lion to open her mouth? She couldn't say it at all!
"Miss, you must seize the opportunity." Uncle Gui tried hard to persuade her. "Although Wu Shuang still can't remember his life experience, he is definitely not from an ordinary family, so you'd better have a good relationship with him now, and even make him fall in love with you. After he recovers his memory, you can ask him to marry you in return, so that you can live a life of glory and wealth, and you don't have to work as hard as you do now."
Although the Bao family has declined, the young lady is still a rich man. He will never watch the young lady work hard for a living. She has to go out to sell steamed buns every day. Wu Shuang is a good target in front of him. Of course, he has to help the young lady find a way to catch it!
Moreover, when the young lady was young, the deceased master once asked someone to tell her fortune and said that the young lady was a lucky person. Therefore, although the Bao family is now in a very poor condition and no one wants to marry the young lady even though she is already twenty years old, he still believes that the young lady will definitely find a wealthy family to marry.
"No, I can't accept this method of repaying you with my body." Bao An'er flatly refused. "Besides, it's still unknown whether he can recover his memory. Uncle Gui, it's useless for you to think so much now."
She didn't want to make fun of her lifelong happiness. If he wasn't the man she liked, she wouldn't marry. And what if Wu Shuang already had a wife?
"But Miss..."
"Uncle Gui, please stop talking for now. When Wu Shuangzhen recovers his memory, it won't be too late for you to talk about this again." She knew that Uncle Gui was doing it for her own good, but she really couldn't force this kind of thing.
"Then...okay." Uncle Gui had no choice but to shut up for the time being, but that didn't mean that he had given up on this plan.
Anyway, it is still unknown what the future will be like, so just wait and see and wait for the opportunity!
Qi Wushuang lay in bed for half a month, and his internal injuries were finally 80% healed. Sometimes Bao An'er came to take care of him personally, and sometimes Uncle Gui took care of him. It seemed that apart from him, the "uninvited guest", they were the only two people living in this house.
Later, I learned from Uncle Gui that the Bao family was originally in the antique business and had many servants. However, since the family fell into decline, the servants gradually dispersed. Now only Bao An'er and Uncle Gui are left in this big house.
On this day, Bao An'er brought medicine to Qi Wushuang as usual. God knows that every time he drank medicine, her heart would bleed, all because of mourning for the money that fell into someone else's pocket!
After he drank the medicine, she tried hard to suppress the bleeding feeling in her heart, smiled and asked with concern: "Wu Shuang, how do you feel about your health today?"
"It's much better, thank you for this." He smiled politely. Now that he was recuperating under the care of others, his attitude was naturally more restrained, and he showed a harmless look that was easy to get along with.
You really should thank me for my momentary mistake! "So... have you recalled anything related to yourself today?" Her eyes were shining brightly, hoping very much that he could answer her - yes!
"Sorry, no."
"Oh, as expected..." She sighed in frustration. She asked him the same question every day, and he gave him the same answer for half a month. She should have died long ago. "You really take things easy. How can you still laugh like this?"
If she had lost her memory, she would have been panicked and overwhelmed, but he was still as stable as a mountain, as if losing his memory did not affect him at all.
"I survived the catastrophe, and I'm lucky to be able to save my life. Even if I really can't recover my past memories, I can only look away early. After all, I still have to live my life, right?" He deliberately pretended to be open-minded.
"That's right..." Bao An'er nodded and asked no more questions. "That's good if you can look away."
She always wantedShe hoped that he could recover his memory as soon as possible, so that she could throw this hot potato back to his family and settle the whole matter completely, but now it seemed that she didn't have too much hope that he could recover his memory, and she would have to talk to him about the "worst case scenario".
Bao An'er moved the round stool beside the table to the bed, then sat down, her original smile disappeared, and she said with a very cautious expression: "Wu Shuang, since your internal injuries have been 80% healed, I think... there are some things that I should talk to you about."
"I'm all ears." He smiled faintly, waiting to see what she would come up with.
Bao An'er was thinking about how to speak, and as she watched him think about it, she unknowingly began to pay attention to his appearance.
He looked like a handsome nobleman. Even though he was only wearing the coarse cloth clothes she had prepared, he could still hide his looming nobility. His original purple shirt was already damaged. Although she felt sorry for the quality of the material, she still had to discard it.
Moreover, when he smiled, that handsome smile seemed to seduce girls into committing crimes. Even her heart beat uncontrollably, making her shy and angry, annoyed that she could be seduced by male lust.
So she doesn't deny that he is a good-looking and attractive man who has the ability to confuse women, and may even make women willing to sacrifice themselves for him.
But this doesn't mean that she will also be confused by him, because she is very self-aware and has no money to support a pretty boy!
"Ahem, even if we are brothers, we have to settle accounts." She finally raised her head in embarrassment. "I think it's necessary to let you know how much money I spent on rescuing you."
Qi Wushuang raised his eyebrows with interest, waiting for her to continue.
Bao An'er took out a small and exquisite wooden abacus directly from her sleeve pocket and started counting in front of him.
"When you stay here, the doctor costs one tael of silver per visit, and he comes twice in total; one dose of medicine costs one hundred cents, and you drink it for half a month, a total of forty-five cents; while you live here, I have to provide you with three meals, which costs about fifty cents a day, and I also prepare five sets of clothes for you, one set is two hundred cents, so it all adds up..." Bao An'er moved the prepared abacus in front of him, smiling a little cunningly. "Eight taels and two hundred and fifty cents, saving a person is really not a simple and easy task."
"So?" Qi Wushuang suppressed a laugh, because her fussy and calculating expression looked really funny in his eyes.
"So, it depends on whether you want to work as a cow and horse in the Bao family to pay off these debts, or go out and find a job to make money so that you can clear out the money." She started to think about it again. "Let me tell you first, I don't have the ability to be a good person, so I can't miss a penny from the calculation. If you go out to find a job, it's better to earn three to five taels of silver a month. Maybe you can pay off the debt in less than three months, but if you plan to work as a cow and horse in the Bao family to pay off the debt, I can only give you one tael of silver a month at most, so you have to work here for eight months."
In fact, she hopes that he can go out to find a job and earn money. If she keeps him here to work as a cow or horse, she won't have much work for him to do. After all, she will still lose more.
What's more, as a man, he should go out and work hard and stop causing trouble to her!
A flash of light flashed in Qi Wu's eyes. When it came to calculating money, could he be worse than her? Bargaining is what he is best at.
Since he was recuperating from his injury in the past half month, he just behaved like a patient and allowed her to round him and flatten him. Now that the injury was almost healed, and she had also made a move on him, asking him to pretend to be his true nature again and let her exploit him all the way with the kindness of saving his life, what would that do?
He is a person who does not suffer losses. If you want to take advantage of him, you have toLet’s see if she has that ability!
Qi Wushuang raised the corners of his lips, his smiling eyes suddenly sharpened, and he formally responded——
"Miss Bao, I think you have made a miscalculation."
"How is that possible?" She is doing calculations every day. She is always careful about money matters and will never make a mistake.
"How about I do the math for you instead." Qi Wushuang took the abacus in Bao An'er's hand and moved the beads very neatly with his fingers, even faster than Bao An'er.
